results.title: Userback Pricing Plans: Choose the Plans That Work For You
results.snippet: Feedback Availability refers to how long your collected feedback is available to view in your Userback account. While all plans let you collect unlimited feedback, the Free plan only lets you view feedback for 7 days. After 7 days, the feedback becomes locked, meaning you won’t be able to view or act on it unless you upgrade to a paid plan.
